mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, which is positive for consumer spending and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a positive signal for economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows down below 2% year-over-year and Industrial Production (INDPRO) declines, it signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal.
